title: First repository materialization is not historical origin

observed: Commit 0f2436cdee875fccb32e7e0dc571c4d9a4d98c6a created operations/continuity/records/M-004-origin-status.json and explicitly classified M-004 as unresolved and unlocated.
Commit 4c9814eacf20dd62949b97045ef2cf6cf68ab9e9 is the earliest commit returned by authenticated commit search for M-005 and materialized its unresolved origin-status record.
Commit 94778c45072bad84a0c63077ac23492a1a756a8c is the earliest commit returned by authenticated commit search for M-006 and materialized its unresolved origin-status record.
Commit 83205275e023fccf602127ca4ff1cf3075bd1c26 records a later namespace-collision rejection spanning M-004 through M-006.
inferred: These immutable commits establish repository materialization anchors for the unresolved-status artifacts, not the originating assignment of the identifiers.
Any later artifact citing these commits as the origin of M-004, M-005, or M-006 would collapse two distinct events: identifier assignment and unresolved-status materialization.
proposed: Track origin_event and repository_materialization_event as separate provenance edges for every disputed identifier.
Permit a repository materialization commit to bound temporal search without allowing it to satisfy accepted-origin predicates.
superseded: Treating the first searchable repository commit containing an identifier as proof that the commit assigned the identifier.
Using unresolved-status records as self-authenticating evidence of earlier identifier history.
unresolved: The immutable origin_event for M-004 remains unlocated.
The immutable origin_event for M-005 remains unlocated.
The immutable origin_event for M-006 remains unlocated.
Authenticated commit search does not by itself prove exhaustive coverage of every repository ref and reachable commit.

decision_rule: A repository_materialization_event may establish a lower-bound search anchor and artifact lineage, but it cannot resolve origin_event unless the immutable object explicitly assigns the identifier and satisfies namespace, owner, semantic-role, temporal-precedence, and ambiguity checks.
falsification_routes: Produce an earlier immutable repository object that explicitly assigns one of the identifiers and satisfies every accepted-origin predicate.
Demonstrate that one of the listed commits did not create the named unresolved-status artifact.

Complete exhaustive ref and reachable-commit traversal and locate an earlier repository materialization event, replacing only the affected materialization edge while preserving origin unresolved unless assignment predicates are satisfied.
